label: copy phase of very short sequences (L=3; L=4 at the 3rd output)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never on original tokens or <DEL>), almost always on the last two outputs (to_go <= 1). It is essentially a short-sequence detector: for L=3 it fires on ~98% of copy steps (t=4,5), and these hold ~73% of activation mass; the strongest activations (max) are at t=5 of L=3 (outputting the 3rd token, input = orig(1)), with t=4 weaker (~0.2-0.6 of max). For L=4 it fires on about 30% of the step outputting token 2 (t=6) and less at t=7, never at t=5; there the firing depends on the input token, mainly o, p, i, e, u, r (o strongest). Activations in L>=5 are rare and weak (~4% of mass). Magnitude goes up with shortness (L=3 > L=4) and with the input token at recall step 2 (o/p/i high). Tokens repeated among the originals (in_count>1) reduce firing. The token list for L=4 is fitted to the data, not principled.
